Report of the International Law Commission
1963
Adopted by the International Law Commission at its fifteenth session, in 1963, and
submitted to the General Assembly as a part of the Commission’s report covering the
work of that session (at para. 18). The report appears in Yearbook of the International
Law Commission, 1963, vol. II.
